newsitem.title: UK: UBS sets $100 mln commodity-linked issue.
newsitem.headline: UBS sets $100 mln commodity-linked issue.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland (Luxembourg) SA has launched a $100 million issue due December 22, 1997 whose redemption value is linked to the value of four commodities, lead manager Union Bank of Switzerland said.

At maturity, investors will be repaid at par and receive a 2.00 percent coupon. They will also receive a further payment if the value of a basket of four commodities -- aluminium, copper, platinum and crude oil -- rises over the life of the issue.
The basket was composed of equal values of the four commodities, $250 apiece, at the time of fixing.
